result.summary: Adds a unit test to verify that peers advertising exactly MIN_PEER_PROTO_VERSION are not disconnected during the version handshake, while peers with lower versions are disconnected.
result.problem: Existing unit and functional tests do not assert that peers at the exact MIN_PEER_PROTO_VERSION boundary remain connected, allowing an off-by-one mutant (`<=` instead of `<`) to survive undetected.
evidence: PR description links to an automated mutation test report showing a surviving mutant in net_processing.cpp where `nVersion < MIN_PEER_PROTO_VERSION` was mutated to `<=`.
result.card: Adds a unit test verifying that peers connecting with exactly MIN_PEER_PROTO_VERSION remain connected while peers below that threshold are disconnected. Existing test coverage did not test this boundary, allowing an off-by-one regression to survive unnoticed. The gap was identified via automated mutation testing of net_processing.cpp.

risk.why: The change only touches unit tests and cannot affect node operation or consensus.
